test_inputs.explanation: The agent navigated repeatedly to the attributes grid URL (shown in Steps 2–5). Step 6 contains a filtered URL whose base64 filter decodes to 'attribute_code=color&is_user_defined=1&is_global=1' (so attribute_code is 'color', scope is 'Global', and is_user_defined=1 corresponds to System = 'No'). wait_seconds set to 1s as the default used between actions.
